'''Kuturmi''', or '''Ibiro-Ikryo''' or '''Ada''', is a [[Plateau languages|Plateau language]]<ref>{{Glottolog|kutu1262|Kutumi}}</ref> cluster of Kachia LGA, [[Kaduna State]], [[Nigeria]].

==Varieties==
Varieties are:<ref name="BlenchAtlas4">{{Cite book|title=An Atlas of Nigerian Languages|last=Blench|first=Roger|publisher=Kay Williamson Educational Foundation|year=2019|edition=4th|location=Cambridge}}</ref>

*'''Ikryo''' (Akru, Aclo, Aklo, West Kuturmi), spoken in two villages of Kachia LGA
*'''Ibiro''' (East Kuturmi), spoken in Antara village, Kachia LGA
